The OpenIE Stack Map (stack.openie.dev) [M/S · unmetered]

Reclassified from reported_j to unmetered (joules = null): stack.openie.dev is a conceptual teaching taxonomy indexing 8 domain portals across Information Theory, Game Theory & Mechanism Design (0 lab runs).

1/2 Three classical sciences by altitude [S]:
- Substrate: Shannon (1948) channel bounds & Landauer (1961) k_B T ln 2 bit-erasure heat
- Strategy: von Neumann-Morgenstern (1944) & Nash (1950)
- Admission rules: Hurwicz, Maskin & Myerson incentive-compatible mechanism design

2/2 Taxonomic & license scope:
- 'Periodic Stacks' is a faceted classification choice (Ranganathan 1933), not an atomic physical constant
- Mixed repo licenses: rce, rce-vc, deterministic-null & lut-adapt-ai are Apache-2.0; JouleDB & Pattern-lang are BSL-1.1; JouleOS is private
